stemMd: Under orthographic projection onto the xy-plane, a point (4,−2,7) is represented by which planar coordinates?
explanationMd: Projection onto the xy-plane retains x and y and discards z. The location is therefore (4,−2); its height above the plane does not alter those coordinates.

distractorRationale.d: This retains x and z, corresponding to another plane.
distractorRationale.a: This swaps coordinates and retains depth.
